RagShortTexts: Sarum households depend on valley farming, herds and woodland goods.
Closed woodland routes interrupt iron and imported salt.

Variants.Content: Households around Sarum depend on valley farming, herds and woodland products. Grain feeds families and assembled fighters; blocked woodland exchange makes iron and imported salt harder to replace.

Sarum households depend on valley farming, herds and woodland goods. Traveling followers need real food from this production; valuables still require a buyer and exchange. Closed woodland routes interrupt iron and imported salt.

Closed woodland routes interrupt iron and imported salt. Collectors and distributors depend on the next yield too; extra demands leave losses with continuing suppliers. Sarum households depend on valley farming, herds and woodland goods.
